about: Corner Brook is a city on Newfoundland’s west coast, at the mouth of the Humber Arm of the Bay of Islands. Pulp-and-paper heritage, a deep harbour, and the surrounding Long Range foothills shape a regional centre for western Newfoundland. It anchors health, education, and retail for communities along the Trans-Canada corridor. About 19,000 people live in Corner Brook.
seoSummary: Western Newfoundland city on the Humber Arm—harbour, pulp-and-paper heritage, and Bay of Islands gateway.
knownFor: Largest city on Newfoundland’s west coast
Humber Arm harbour and Bay of Islands setting
Regional service hub for western Newfoundland
